Analytics Context Layer cases

click

A link and a button outside any data-analytics-event send nothing

Contact 
[]

A link sends the event named by its component, with its text, URL and the component parameters

See the deals 
[{ "event": "component_click", "link_text": "See the deals", "link_url": "/sale", "component": "promo" }]

A phone link

02 0000 0000 
[{ "event": "component_click", "link_text": "02 0000 0000", "link_url": "tel:0200000000", "component": "promo" }]

A link to another site

Visit our partner 
[{ "event": "component_click", "link_text": "Visit our partner", "link_url": "https://example.com/partner", "component": "promo" }]

A link to a section of the page

Jump to the form 
[{ "event": "component_click", "link_text": "Jump to the form", "link_url": "#form", "component": "promo" }]

A button sends its text and no URL

[{ "event": "component_click", "link_text": "Menu", "component": "promo" }]

A submit input and an input button send their value as the text

[
  { "event": "component_click", "link_text": "Subscribe", "component": "promo" },
  { "event": "component_click", "link_text": "Clear", "component": "promo" }
]

An anchor without an address and plain text send nothing

An anchor without an address

Plain text

[]

A middle click sends the event and a right click sends nothing

See the deals 
[{ "event": "component_click", "link_text": "See the deals", "link_url": "/sale" }]

Nested components: the closest event name and the closest of each parameter win

Read more: Spring sale
About us
Summer sale
Get in touch Contact 
[
  { "event": "component_click", "link_text": "Read more: Spring sale", "link_url": "/sale/spring", "component": "card", "layout": "grid" },
  { "event": "component_click", "link_text": "About us", "link_url": "/about", "component": "section", "layout": "grid" },
  { "event": "card_click", "link_text": "Summer sale", "link_url": "/sale/summer", "component": "section", "layout": "grid" },
  { "event": "contact_click", "link_text": "Get in touch", "link_url": "/contact", "component": "section", "layout": "grid", "position": "2" },
  { "event": "component_click", "link_text": "Custom text", "link_url": "/contact", "component": "section", "layout": "grid" }
]

A skipped link and a link inside a skipped element send nothing

Terms
Privacy 
[]

Link text skips hidden content and comments, then falls back to aria-label and title

→ Contact us 
[
  { "event": "component_click", "link_text": "Contact us", "link_url": "/contact" },
  { "event": "component_click", "link_text": "Call us", "link_url": "tel:0200000000" },
  { "event": "component_click", "link_text": "Contact the team", "link_url": "/contact" },
  { "event": "component_click", "link_text": "", "link_url": "/contact" }
]

form_start

The first focus in a marked form sends 1 event with the form and its ancestors' parameters

[{ "event": "form_start", "form_name": "contact", "form_id": "form-start-contact", "form_destination": "/contact", "form_type": "enquiry", "section": "contact" }]

A marked wrapper without an ID or address sends only the form name

[{ "event": "form_start", "form_name": "newsletter" }]

A form without an address sends no destination

[{ "event": "form_start", "form_name": "callback", "form_id": "form-start-callback" }]

A skipped field doesn't start the form; the next focus does

[{ "event": "form_start", "form_name": "quote", "form_id": "form-start-quote" }]

A form without data-analytics-form sends nothing

[]

field_complete

A field is named by its label, without hidden content

[{ "event": "field_complete", "form_name": "apply", "form_id": "field-label-form", "form_destination": "/apply", "field_name": "full_name", "field_label": "Full name" }]

A field inside its label

[{ "event": "field_complete", "form_name": "apply", "form_id": "field-wrapping-label-form", "field_name": "phone", "field_label": "Phone" }]

A textarea and a select are named by their labels, never their content

[
  { "event": "field_complete", "form_name": "apply", "form_id": "field-textarea-select-form", "field_name": "message", "field_label": "Message" },
  { "event": "field_complete", "form_name": "apply", "form_id": "field-textarea-select-form", "field_name": "state", "field_label": "State" }
]

Radios and checkboxes in a fieldset use its legend; a loose radio never uses its own label

Contact method 
[
  { "event": "field_complete", "form_name": "apply", "form_id": "field-options-form", "field_name": "method", "field_label": "Contact method" },
  { "event": "field_complete", "form_name": "apply", "form_id": "field-options-form", "field_name": "callback", "field_label": "" },
  { "event": "field_complete", "form_name": "apply", "form_id": "field-options-form", "field_name": "callback", "field_label": "Callback" },
  { "event": "field_complete", "form_name": "apply", "form_id": "field-options-form", "field_name": "terms", "field_label": "I accept the terms" }
]

A field falls back to aria-label; a label parameter overrides; a bare field sends an empty label

[
  { "event": "field_complete", "form_name": "apply", "form_id": "field-fallbacks-form", "field_name": "reference", "field_label": "Reference number" },
  { "event": "field_complete", "form_name": "apply", "form_id": "field-fallbacks-form", "field_label": "Custom label" },
  { "event": "field_complete", "form_name": "apply", "form_id": "field-fallbacks-form", "field_label": "" }
]

Every change sends an event

[
  { "event": "field_complete", "form_name": "apply", "form_id": "field-every-change-form", "field_name": "suburb", "field_label": "Suburb" },
  { "event": "field_complete", "form_name": "apply", "form_id": "field-every-change-form", "field_name": "suburb", "field_label": "Suburb" }
]

A skipped field and a field outside a marked form send nothing

[]

form_submit

A confirmation rendered with the page sends the event on load; a skipped one sends nothing

Thank you for your enquiry.

[{ "event": "form_submit", "form_name": "contact", "form_type": "enquiry" }]

A confirmation added after load sends the event, even when nested; markup without a marker sends nothing

[
  { "event": "form_submit", "form_name": "newsletter", "section": "newsletter" },
  { "event": "form_submit", "form_name": "callback", "section": "newsletter" }
]

The site can report a confirmed submission from its own code

[{ "event": "form_submit", "form_name": "quote", "form_step": "2" }]

Privacy

Typed text and email values are never sent

[
  { "event": "form_start", "form_name": "private", "form_id": "privacy-text-form" },
  { "event": "field_complete", "form_name": "private", "form_id": "privacy-text-form", "field_name": "name", "field_label": "Name" },
  { "event": "field_complete", "form_name": "private", "form_id": "privacy-text-form", "field_name": "email", "field_label": "Email" }
]

Textarea content, pre-filled or typed, is never sent

[
  { "event": "form_start", "form_name": "private", "form_id": "privacy-textarea-form" },
  { "event": "field_complete", "form_name": "private", "form_id": "privacy-textarea-form", "field_name": "message", "field_label": "Message" }
]

The chosen option, radio or checkbox is never sent

Situation
Needs 
[
  { "event": "form_start", "form_name": "private", "form_id": "privacy-choices-form" },
  { "event": "field_complete", "form_name": "private", "form_id": "privacy-choices-form", "field_name": "answer", "field_label": "Answer" },
  { "event": "field_complete", "form_name": "private", "form_id": "privacy-choices-form", "field_name": "situation", "field_label": "Situation" },
  { "event": "field_complete", "form_name": "private", "form_id": "privacy-choices-form", "field_name": "needs", "field_label": "Needs" }
]

A textarea inside a clicked link adds nothing to the link text

Help 
[{ "event": "form_click", "link_text": "Help", "link_url": "/help" }]
